title: Reconciliation
description: Mirrors a2a_compliance.lifecycle.Reconciliation exactly for its required core: state, certified, action_digest, missing_receipts, open_receipts, failed_receipts, invalid_receipts, reason. state reuses lifecycle.RunState's actual values (PLANNED/ASSESSED/ADMITTED/HELD/ROUTED_HUMAN/REFUSED/DISPATCHED/RECONCILED/CERTIFIED) — NOT the plan's prose state-machine names (RECEIVED/GROUNDED/EVALUATED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/OBSERVED/RESIDUAL_OPEN), which do not exist in code; see docs/enforcement/threat-model.md for this flagged discrepancy. The plan's fuller Reconciliation description (intended vs observed effects, discharged obligations, residuals) is E4 scope (effect-reconciliation, obligation-discharge repos); this schema reserves optional forward fields for it without requiring them in E0.

intended_effects_digest.description: E4 forward field; not required in E0

observed_effects_digest.description: E4 forward field; not required in E0

discharged_obligations.description: E4 forward field; not required in E0

residuals.description: E4 forward field; not required in E0
